1. Open `docs/q3_report.md`.

3. Open `docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt`.

   `Report summary prepared by Rachel Kim and Claire Fontaine.`

7. Save `docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt`.

If you prefer a terminal command, first back up the notes, then append the report:

```bash
cp docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt.bak
{
  printf '\n\nQ3 2026 Business Report Summary\n'
  printf 'Attributed to: Rachel Kim and Claire Fontaine\n\n'
  cat docs/q3_report.md
} >> docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt
```

Note that this command appends the report to the end of the file. If the September 8 notes are not at the end, manual insertion is safer.
